Notes:
Incident Number is not surfaced directly in Records.IncidentReport, but can be derived from Report Number. 

Don't use LatestIncidentReport because earlier reports are not included. (-1 won't show up if -3 has an arrest on it)
Raw form json data is not exposed in V2

Instead of one column with many values, V2 utilizes multiple columns with a binary value to indicate specific Case Factors:

'1' indicates a Yes
'0' indicates a No

CustomUsCaseFactorsOnlineReportCount 
CustomUsCaseFactorsK9DeploymentCount
CustomUsCaseFactorsNonFatalshootingCount
CustomUsCaseFactorsK9DeploymentCount
CustomUsCaseFactorsOfficerInvolvedShootingCount

V1 required multiple entries in case of multiple Case Factors, V2 resolves that

In the case of K9 Deployments, determining K9 Bite or K9 Show of Force require checking the value of CustomUsCaseFactorsK9DeploymentList
